edition.witness_note: Single locked witness in repo; second witness not yet locked.

source_text: Καὶ παρ᾿ ἡμῖν ἔστιν ἰδεῖν καὶ θηλείας καὶ ἄρσενας, χαρίσματα ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ θεοῦ ἔχοντας. Ὥστε οὐ διὰ τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐνδεῆ δυνάμεως ἐπεπροφήτευτο ἐλεύσεσθαι ἐπ᾿ αὐτὸν τὰς δυνάμεις τὰς κατηριθμημένας ὑπὸ Ἡσαΐου, ἀλλὰ διὰ τὸ ἐπέκεινα μὴ μέλλειν ἔσεσθαι.
pass_a_gloss: And there are with us females and males having gifts from the Spirit of God. So it was not because He was lacking in power that it was prophesied that the powers enumerated by Isaiah would come upon Him, but because what is beyond was not going to be.
pass_b_english: We can see both women and men among us who possess gifts from the Spirit of God. Therefore, it was not because He lacked power that it was prophesied the powers enumerated by Isaiah would come upon Him, but because what lies beyond was not going to be.

anf_compare.notes: Drafted from source only; ANF not shown to drafter.

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Greek text. Pass A and Pass B both correctly handle the negation (οὐ διὰ τὸ εἶναι... ἀλλὰ διὰ τὸ...) and the agency of the Spirit and God. The Isaiah reference is correctly identified.
